subject: Re: PO structure & billing rhythm for CareNova renewal
messages:
From: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@carenova.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO requirements and discount ladder for upcoming renewal

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the kickoff call earlier. Procurement has a few gating items we need to capture before legal issues a blanket PO for the renewal. Can you confirm the following so we can move through our AP process?

Requirements from our side:
- PO must reference Master Agreement: "MA-CN-2023" and include the Renewal SOW line item number.
- Each invoice must include the PO number and a line-level SKU mapping (your internal SKU -> our GL account).
- We operate on net45 standard; prefer monthly invoices (one invoice per month) rather than weekly.
- We can aggregate charges under a blanket PO if invoices still show line-level items.

Pricing/discount question:
- CareNova is evaluating a 12-month commit (~$220k ARR). Is there a pricing ladder for commit size (e.g., 5% at $100k, 10% at $180k, 12% at $200k+)? If so, what documentation do you need from procurement to qualify?

I've attached our PO template and procurement policy for reference. If you can reply with a short mutual action plan and the fields we need to populate, that would be ideal.

Best,
Jamie Lin
Senior Procurement Manager | CareNova
procurement@carenova.com

Attachments: PO_template.xlsx (spreadsheet), procurement_policy.pdf (pdf)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@carenova.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and discount ladder for upcoming renewal

Jamie — thanks for the clear list. Short answers and next steps below.

Quick answers:
- We can accept a blanket PO that references MA-CN-2023 and include the SOW line item. Good.
- Invoices: we typically issue monthly statements that include line-level SKU mapping and the PO number on each invoice. We can match your GL mapping if you provide the mapping file.
- Net terms: our standard for renewals is net30. For larger committed ARR (>= $200k) we can be flexible to net45 or net60 as part of commercial concessions — finance needs to sign off.
- Discount ladder: we offer an annual-commit discount schedule. Preliminary: 5% for $100k+, 9% for $150k+, 12% for $200k+. I'll confirm exact bands with finance.

Actions I'm taking now (ETA in parentheses):
1) Attaching our Pricing_worksheet.csv with the proposed banding and effective list prices (attached) — please confirm your desired committed amount and we can map to the bands. (attached)
2) Looping in Kim (cc) to confirm whether finance can approve net45 for $220k ARR; she'll advise on documentation we need.
3) We'll return a redlined PO header if there are any standard vendor-side fields we cannot accept.

Can you confirm whether your AP requires invoice PDFs plus a remittance CSV, or just one of the two? Also confirm the exact GL codes you want in the SKU mapping column of the PO template.

Thanks — I'll follow up once Kim replies.

— Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachments: Pricing_worksheet.csv

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@carenova.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and discount ladder for upcoming renewal

Aditya / Jamie — finance here. A few clarifications from AP/credit: 

- Net terms: I can provisionally approve net45 for the $220k commit if CareNova provides a PO that: (a) references MA-CN-2023, (b) is a blanket PO with monthly invoice caps, and (c) includes the billing entity tax ID on the PO header.
- Invoice cadence: monthly invoices are fine. Please note we require each invoice to include a remittance field (ACH details or remit-to address) for automated processing.
- SKU mapping: we can accept your mapping in either the PO line description or a separate CSV. Prefer separate CSV attached to the invoice for ERP ingestion.
- Early-pay/volume discounts: finance can offer an additional 2% early-pay discount if payment settles within 15 days. Larger percentage discounts (9–12%) need revenue ops approval (I will route if you confirm the committed ARR).

I've attached an internal doc that lists the minimum PO header fields we need (PO_requirements.docx). Jamie — if you can populate the header and the SKU->GL mapping, we can fast-track.

Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: PO_requirements.docx

From: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@carenova.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and discount ladder for upcoming renewal

Thanks Kim — that gets us most of the way there. A couple of follow-ups from procurement: 

- Net45 is our default; we prefer not to include early-pay language in the master PO unless it is optional add-on language on the invoice because our treasury team handles early-pay via a separate portal. Can Redwood still publish the 2% early-pay discount on invoices as an optional line item?
- Our AP wants invoices and a remittance CSV. We'll populate your SKU->GL mapping in the separate CSV and attach it to each monthly invoice.
- Regarding the larger commit discount: Procurement will accept the 12% band as long as it is documented in the SOW/PO and invoiced against the committed line item. Can you provide a short confirmation email stating the discount ladder is applicable to the 12-month committed spend and will be applied pro-rata if the full committed amount is not reached?

Forwarding our procurement policy (excerpt attached) for your review. If you can send the confirmation on the discount ladder and the PO header we will generate the blanket PO by EOD Thursday and route it for signatures.

Best,
Jamie

Attachments: procurement_policy.pdf

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@carenova.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO requirements and discount ladder for upcoming renewal

Jamie / Kim — appreciate the quick turn. To summarize the mutual action plan and confirm the commercial commitments so procurement can issue the blanket PO: 

1) Commercial commitments and discounts (confirmed):
   - CareNova commits to 12 months at the projected ARR of $220,000. Redwood will apply a 12% annual-commit discount to the committed line item. If realized spend for the 12-month period is below the committed amount, discounts will be applied pro-rata across invoices; any reconciliation will occur at the end of the term.
   - Redwood Finance will include an optional 2% early-pay discount on invoice line items (applied at invoice level if Redwood receives payment within 15 days). This is optional and will not change the PO header.

2) PO / invoice formatting (what Redwood needs):
   - PO must reference MA-CN-2023 and include the SOW line item.
   - Please include your billing entity tax ID in the PO header and populate the SKU->GL mapping in the separate CSV attached to each invoice.
   - Invoices will be issued monthly (one invoice per month). Each invoice PDF must include the PO number and we will attach a remittance CSV for ERP ingestion.

3) Next steps and timeline:
   - Jamie: please send the blanket PO (using your template) with header fields filled and the SKU->GL mapping by EOD Thursday 6/3. Send to billing@redwood.com and cc finance@redwood.com.
   - Kim/Finance: will provisionally approve net45 for this deal once PO header and tax ID are confirmed. Final net-term sign-off occurs on receipt of the PO.
   - Commercial: we'll lock pricing in HubSpot and attach DocuSign for the SOW if any signature is required.

If that summary looks right I'll mark the deal stage accordingly and expect the PO Thursday. Thanks everyone — happy to hop on a 15-minute sync if helpful.

— Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
